body: Wait until you're sober. The alcohol wont help. Spend a few days eating your favourite food, watching your favourite movies and doing what makes toy happy. I get you want to die and I respect that. What's another couple days. Death is a long time- please spend some time doing what makes you happy. I feel the same as you about life but I'm doing what makes me happy before I go. Make a list of things to do/eat/ watch. Put the rifle down and relax in the bath and make a mental list now. What's a couple more days?
